diagrams.title: Three independent rulings, temperature 0
diagrams.caption: Three independent rulings, temperature 0.5–0.8, no shared history between them. On the right, one judge would happily have approved a refund on a claim nothing can prove. The two dissenters are what send it to a human instead of to the payments API.

diagrams.title: Stage 2 must finish before stage 3 can start — you cannot fan out until you know how many grievances there are
diagrams.caption: Stage 2 must finish before stage 3 can start — you cannot fan out until you know how many grievances there are. That single sequential call is why wall-clock time is set by the fan-out that follows it, not by the number of stages.

diagrams.title: The white hairlines inside stage 3 are the waves
diagrams.caption: The white hairlines inside stage 3 are the waves: 12 calls going out four at a time is 3 rounds, not one burst. Raise the parallelism and that band shortens; add grievances or raise K and it lengthens. The three blue bars never move.

diagrams.title: The blue slivers at both ends are identical in all three bars
diagrams.caption: The blue slivers at both ends are identical in all three bars. Adding grievances or raising K stretches only the middle. That asymmetry is why every operational lever — batch size, worker cap, retry policy, the partial-settlement rule — is aimed at stage 3 and ignores the rest.
